d: The Executive Director – Technology Lead is a foundational executive role responsible for defining, governing, and delivering end-to-end sports technology strategy across all Sports Business Unit assets, from early planning and concept design through construction, commissioning, and structured transition into operations under the Asset Management organization.

In line with the current SBU TOM, the role does not assume responsibility for day-to-day asset operations once venues are handed over to the Asset Management team. Instead, it ensures that sports venues are designed, delivered, and documented with full lifecycle integrity, and that the technology intent, architectural decisions, and integration logic are effectively transferred, supported, and retained as organizational knowledge.

The role establishes SBU as the custodian of technology design intent and institutional memory, enabling Asset Management and operators to run assets efficiently, evolve them safely, and avoid long-term technical debt. This continuity reflects global best practice, recognizing that technology-led assets require ongoing involvement of the original design authority to support optimization, upgrades, servicing strategies, and future-proofing—without blurring operational accountability.

Through this approach, the role ensures Qiddiya’s sports assets remain globally competitive, future-ready, and fully integrated with the wider Qiddiya city technology ecosystem across their entire lifecycle.
Define together with Qiddiya Tech and Asset Management the SBU Technology Strategy aligned with the Sports BU Target Operating Model and the Qiddiya Technology Mandate & Operating Model (QTMOM).
Represent SBU at executive level within the Qiddiya-wide Technology Board ( as per QTMOM )and related governance forums.
Establish clear decision rights, standards, and lifecycle ownership for technologies across all assets.
Act as executive technology authority across Stage Gates for all sports assets (stadiums, arenas, academies, training centers, public sport facilities).
Ensure technology requirements are embedded early in master planning, concept design, and detailed design, avoiding retrofits and value leakage.
Oversee complex technology scopes including digital infrastructure, smart venues, broadcast, fan experience, performance tech, data platforms, and cyber security.
Lead technology delivery for multi-asset sports ecosystems, not standalone venues — including integrated sports districts, mixed-use developments, and city-scale environments.
Ensure seamless integration with mobility, smart city platforms, digital identity, payments, and city operations.
Co-create and lead an industry-leading Sports Technology Partnership Program in close collaboration with Qiddiya Strategy and Commercial teams.
Structure long-term partnerships (OEMs, integrators, telcos, cloud, media, data, performance tech) generating hundreds of millions to potentially billions SAR in:
Direct revenues (sponsorships, naming rights, data & media monetization)
q: 15+ years of senior technology leadership, including executive ownership of technology for major sports venues and sports organizations.
Proven experience delivering large-scale, complex sports and entertainment assets from design through live operations (stadiums, arenas, mixed-use districts).
Demonstrated success integrating technology across sports districts or metropolitan-scale developments (e.g., stadium + entertainment + commercial + public realm).
Former or current CTO / EVP / Executive Technology Leader for:
Exceptional ability to operate at the intersection of technology, design, and executive governance.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

d: For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.
q: 2 years of experince in Retail preferably fashion.

d: We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer with experience in the fashion and e-commerce industry. The ideal candidate should have a strong visual sense and the ability to create engaging designs for digital platforms, social media, online stores, and marketing campaigns while maintaining brand consistency.
q: Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience as a Graphic Designer, preferably in fashion, e-commerce, jewellery, accessories, or beauty.
Strong portfolio showcasing fashion-related designs, social media creatives, and digital marketing campaigns.
Experience working with fashion brands, jewellery, accessories, beauty, or multi-brand retail is highly preferred.
Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, knowledge of InDesign is an advantage.
Experience creating social media creatives, digital advertisements, and e-commerce website banners.
Good understanding of typography, colour combinations, layouts, and visual branding.
Knowledge of image editing, retouching, and product photography enhancement.
Creative mindset, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.
Available to join immediately with a Valid Qatar ID.
Important: Applicants must share a portfolio or links to previous design projects. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
r: Design creative visuals for social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and Snapchat.
Create promotional banners, website graphics, landing page visuals, and product-related creatives for e-commerce platforms.
Develop designs for seasonal campaigns, product launches, new arrivals, sales, and promotional offers.
Edit and enhance fashion product images, including retouching, resizing, and background adjustments.
Create engaging digital advertisements and marketing materials.
Collaborate with the marketing and social media teams to develop creative concepts and campaign visuals.
Ensure brand consistency across all digital and marketing materials.
Manage multiple design projects and meet deadlines.
